role: C04 bounded individual contextual source review
decision: The upstream patch changes CDK no-data row and cell class application, adds modern Material MDC classes, and excludes the modern no-data row and cells from harness selectors. Material 16 legacy row specifies mat-no-data-row; the owned adapter sets that row class, suppresses extra cell classes and uses legacy row/cell harness selectors. Retain that historical styling rather than copy the modern MDC classes. The current CDK still performs row creation and class application; the November 8 table exception specifically permits the existing no-data adapter fields but does not qualify their behavior. Native and flex transitions, exact class attributes including consumer-authored classes, and harness exclusion remain unexecuted and open.
